_doc: Working-hours save validation. advanceCases: BVA of the advance-booking window (integer 1..730, WorkingHoursSettings); invalid values are blocked before any DB write (the field flags itself inline; helperText shows '1–730'); the two valid boundaries REALLY save (waiting for the saved-toast) and are then restored to the original value (self-clean submit). scheduleCases: decision coverage of dayScheduleIssue on Monday (blocked saves, page reloaded between cases). breakOutsideHours is NOT reachable through the UI — setBreakField clamps break times into the working window — so it appears here as breakClampCase (asserting the clamp) and is verified logically via the invariants. Driven by e2e/data-driven/working-hours.spec.ts.

advanceCases.note: 1 = lower boundary — really saved, then restored
730 = upper boundary — really saved, then restored

breakClampCase.note: typing a break start before opening time is clamped to the window (breakOutsideHours is unreachable via the UI; covered logically by the invariants)
